newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner wins NOK 600 mln deal from Elf.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner wins NOK 600 mln deal from Elf.

text.p: Anglo-Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner ASA said on Thursday its oil and gas division had been awarded a 600 million crown ($78.9 million) contract by Elf Exploration UK Plc.
The contract is for the engineering, procurement, fabrication, transportation and installation of the decks for the Elgin A and Franklin wellhead platforms on the British continental shelf.
Kvaerner said the engineering element of the work will be carried out at Kvaerner Oil & Gas Ltd's London offices, with fabrication at the Port Clarence year in Middlesbrough, Teeside.
Each deck will weigh about 2,000 tonnes. Construction is scheduled to begin in March, 1998 for delivery during the second quarter 1999.
